findings.problem: Components reopened lock paths after complete admission; complete receipts did not reconcile consumed lock identity.
findings.fix: Retain both admitted byte buffers, pass immutable slices to shared component cores, remove transaction lock-path parameters, and require receipt source.lockSha256 matches admitted identity before proceeding.

findings.problem: Three metadata-screened file readers used unbounded fs::read/read_to_end after observing a maximum length.
findings.fix: One shared reader validates path/opened-file type and length, allocates a fixed admitted extent, read_exact into it and probes one stack byte for EOF. Observed truncation/growth rejects without expanding allocation.
